operations.name: array_import
operations.description: Convert inline JSON, CSV, a read-only .npy or a safetensors tensor into a new F64 safetensors artifact; fails with CONFLICT if out exists

params.name: format
params.description: json: inline array or {shape,data}; csv: inline CSV text; csv_file/npy: path to .csv/.npy; safetensors: path.safetensors#key.

params.name: data
params.description: Source data selected by format. Inline sources hold at most 1000 numbers, files at most 200000.

params.name: key
params.description: Tensor name in the output artifact: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}.

params.name: header
params.description: csv/csv_file only: skip the first line as a header.

params.name: na
params.description: Missing values (null, NA, empty CSV field): store NaN, or fail with NA_NOT_ALLOWED.

params.name: out
params.description: New .safetensors path inside the working directory.

operations.name: array_inspect
operations.description: Shape, dtype, finite/NaN/Inf counts, min, max, norm and a preview of an array (<=1000 numbers); a bare .safetensors path lists its tensors from the header only

params.name: ref
params.description: Inline array, file.npy, file.safetensors#key, or file.safetensors to list tensors.

params.name: limit
params.description: Preview length, 1..1000.

operations.name: la_lstsq
operations.description: Dense least squares / minimum-norm solve (scipy.linalg.lstsq); statuses OK, RANK_DEFICIENT, NO_CONVERGENCE, NUMERICAL_FAILURE; read form returns at most 1000 inline numbers (x + residues + singular values), write form stores x (and large residues/singular values) as safetensors

params.name: a
params.description: m-by-n matrix, finite.

params.name: b
params.description: Right-hand side with m rows (vector or m-by-k).

params.name: rcond
params.description: Singular values below rcond*largest are treated as zero, in [0,1); default machine epsilon.

params.name: driver
params.description: LAPACK driver.

operations.name: la_lstsq_to
operations.description: Dense least squares / minimum-norm solve (scipy.linalg.lstsq); statuses OK, RANK_DEFICIENT, NO_CONVERGENCE, NUMERICAL_FAILURE; read form returns at most 1000 inline numbers (x + residues + singular values), write form stores x (and large residues/singular values) as safetensors

params.name: a

params.name: b

params.name: rcond

operations.name: la_props
operations.description: Scalar matrix properties: det, slogdet, rank, cond, norm, trace and optionally the inverse (<=1000 numbers); status OK, SINGULAR (inverse withheld) or NO_CONVERGENCE; cond is Inf for rank-deficient input

params.name: a
params.description: Finite matrix.

params.name: what
params.description: Properties to compute; default det, rank, cond, norm, trace.

params.name: norm_ord
params.description: Matrix norm order.

params.name: cond_p
params.description: Condition number norm; values other than 2 need a square matrix.

params.name: rank_tol
params.description: Rank threshold on singular values; default max(m,n)*eps*sigma_max.

operations.name: la_decomp
operations.description: Matrix factorization written to a new safetensors artifact: svd (u,s,vt), qr (q,r[,p]), eig (w_re,w_im,vr_re,vr_im), eigh (w,v), cholesky (l or u), lu (p,l,u with A=P@L@U); statuses OK, NOT_POSITIVE_DEFINITE, NO_CONVERGENCE, NUMERICAL_FAILURE (write ops fail with the status as tool_code)

params.name: a
params.description: Finite matrix; eigh/cholesky need exact symmetry, eig/eigh/cholesky need a square matrix.

params.name: kind
params.description: Factorization.

params.name: out
params.description: New .safetensors path.

params.name: full
params.description: svd/qr: full_matrices / full Q instead of economic.

params.name: pivoting
params.description: qr only: column pivoting, adds int64 tensor p with A[:,p]=Q@R.

params.name: lower
params.description: cholesky only: false returns the upper factor u.

operations.name: opt_linprog
operations.description: Dense LP/MILP via HiGHS with row/objective scaling and original-data primal/KKT checks. Status OK/INFEASIBLE/UNBOUNDED/INFEASIBLE_OR_UNBOUNDED/MODEL_ERROR/TIME_LIMIT/NODE_LIMIT/ITERATION_LIMIT/NUMERICAL_FAILURE. LP dual signs follow the original objective. outputs_in_artifact reports descriptors for x/slack/duals; use array_inspect for previews.

params.name: c
params.description: Finite objective vector, 1..512 variables; inline <=1000 or npy/safetensors#key. All LP inputs have finite abs <=1e15; nonzero coefficient ratios per row/objective >=1e-9.

params.name: a_ub
params.description: Dense inequality matrix; a_ub*x<=b_ub. Combined matrices <=200000 entries /4096 rows.

params.name: b_ub
params.description: Inequality RHS vector; required with a_ub.

params.name: a_eq
params.description: Dense equality matrix; a_eq*x=b_eq.

params.name: b_eq
params.description: Equality RHS vector; required with a_eq.

params.name: bounds
params.description: Per-variable [lower,upper], equal bounds allowed. Default [0,Inf]; null or signed -Inf/Inf tokens for open bounds; finite abs <=1e15.

params.name: integrality
params.description: One continuous/integer/binary enum per variable; binary intersects bounds with [0,1].

params.name: maximize
params.description: Maximize original c*x instead of minimizing.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Solver wall budget seconds, >0..30, bounded by process budget.

params.name: node_limit
params.description: MILP node cap, 0..100000.

params.name: maxiter
params.description: LP iteration cap, 1..100000.

params.name: mip_rel_gap
params.description: MILP relative gap target, 0..0.1; actual mip_gap returned.

operations.name: ode_solve
operations.description: Budgeted solve_ivp with closed RHS/event ASTs. Status OK/EVAL_LIMIT/TIME_LIMIT/STEP_LIMIT/EVENT_LIMIT/NON_FINITE/STEP_SIZE_TOO_SMALL/NO_CONVERGENCE. Non-OK trajectories are partial with termination failed. outputs_in_artifact identifies trajectory refs. Read form never writes; use ode_solve_to for large output.

params.name: rhs
params.description: One scalar expression per state: list using y[i], t, params; or object matching named y0.

params.name: y0
params.description: Finite state array or named object; 1..32 states. Named states sorted by name.

params.name: states
params.description: Optional state aliases for array y0; unique, non-reserved, distinct from t/y/params.

params.name: params
params.description: At most 16 named finite scalar parameters, default empty.

params.name: t_span
params.description: Two distinct finite times, absolute values <=1e12; forward or reverse.

params.name: t_eval
params.description: Strictly ordered times within t_span; inline or npy/safetensors ref, <=10000. Missing endpoints are added and reported.

params.name: max_output_points
params.description: Uniform grid size when t_eval omitted, 2..10000. Duplicate representable times removed; effective_output_points reports the count. Output budget <=200000 numbers.

params.name: method
params.description: Closed solve_ivp method. Stiff problems: use BDF/Radau/LSODA; default RK45 can exhaust the 10s budget (TIME_LIMIT/STEP_LIMIT/EVAL_LIMIT, partial state).

params.name: rtol
params.description: Relative tolerance, 1e-13..0.1.

params.name: atol
params.description: Absolute tolerance scalar or one per state, 1e-15..0.1.

params.name: max_step
params.description: Optional positive finite maximum step <=1e12.

params.name: events
params.description: At most four {expr,direction:-1|0|1,terminal:boolean} events. Zeros at t_span[0] are not roots. event_index is integer; nonterminal cap 32 roots gives EVENT_LIMIT.

params.name: max_evals
params.description: Shared RHS-component/event expression cap, 1..200000. Counts finite-difference RHS calls too.

params.name: max_steps
params.description: Accepted adaptive step cap, 1..20000.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative solve wall seconds, >0..30, checked on every expression evaluation.

operations.name: opt_minimize
operations.description: Minimise a scalar expression with scipy.optimize.minimize (closed method list). Statuses OK, NO_CONVERGENCE, EVAL_LIMIT, TIME_LIMIT, NON_FINITE; EVAL_LIMIT/TIME_LIMIT/NON_FINITE return the best point so far by objective value, which can be infeasible when constraints exist (see constraint_violation); gradients by finite differences unless gradient expressions are given (checked at x0, every evaluation counted). Result: par, fun, nit, nfev, evals, nonfinite_evals, constraint_violation

params.name: objective
params.description: Expression (<=2048 bytes, 512 nodes) in the unknowns and data columns; sum/mean/prod/min/max reducers only with data.

params.name: x0
params.description: Start values {name: number | [numbers]} (names [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}; at most 64 scalars). A vector variable is used as name[0], name[1] with integer literals. Variables are ordered by name, vector components by index.

params.name: method
params.description: Default: SLSQP with constraints, L-BFGS-B with bounds, else BFGS. Bounds: not BFGS. Constraints: SLSQP, trust-constr. Gradient expressions: not Nelder-Mead/Powell.

params.name: bounds
params.description: {name: [lower, upper]} with null/"-Inf"/"Inf" for open ends; for a vector unknown one pair is applied to every component, or give per-component pairs [[lo0, hi0], [lo1, hi1], ...] (exactly one per component). lower < upper and x0 inside.

params.name: constraints
params.description: Up to 16 {"type":"eq"|"ineq","expr":...}; ineq means expr >= 0.

params.name: gradient
params.description: One expression per scalar unknown (sorted name order); checked against finite differences at x0.

params.name: data
params.description: Data columns {name: inline array (<=1000 numbers) | file.npy | file.safetensors#key}: finite vectors of equal length (<=200000), at most 32.

params.name: tol
params.description: Solver tolerance in (0, 1]; default is the method's own.

params.name: maxiter
params.description: Iteration cap, 1..10000.

params.name: max_evals
params.description: Cap on expression evaluations, 1..2000000; EVAL_LIMIT returns the best point so far.

params.name: nonfinite
params.description: inf: a non-finite objective counts as +Inf; error: stop with status NON_FINITE.

operations.name: opt_least_squares
operations.description: Nonlinear least squares with scipy.optimize.least_squares (trf/dogbox/lm): model y ~ f(data; params) or a residual expression list. Result: par, std_err (central-difference Jacobian with adaptive per-parameter steps: cov = (J'J)^-1 times 2*cost/(m-n) unless absolute_sigma; columns equilibrated and the Jacobian declared singular below a 1e-8 relative singular value, reported as cov_status SINGULAR_JACOBIAN with jacobian_condition), cost, rss, status OK/NO_CONVERGENCE/EVAL_LIMIT/TIME_LIMIT/NON_FINITE, cov_status

params.name: model
params.description: Expression in the unknowns and data columns; residual = (model - response)/sigma.

params.name: response
params.description: Data column fitted by model.

params.name: residuals
params.description: Alternative to model: 1..64 residual expressions (each scalar or vector over data columns), concatenated.

params.name: x0
params.description: Start values {name: number | [numbers]} (names [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}; at most 64 scalars). A vector variable is used as name[0], name[1] with integer literals. Variables are ordered by name, vector components by index.

params.name: data
params.description: Data columns {name: inline array (<=1000 numbers) | file.npy | file.safetensors#key}: finite vectors of equal length (<=200000), at most 32.

params.name: bounds
params.description: As opt_minimize; not with method lm.

params.name: method
params.description: lm needs at least as many residuals as unknowns, no bounds, linear loss.

params.name: loss
params.description: Robust loss; std_err then uses the robust cost (documented).

params.name: f_scale
params.description: Loss scale, > 0.

params.name: sigma
params.description: model only: name of a positive data column or a positive number; residuals are divided by it.

params.name: absolute_sigma
params.description: Treat sigma as absolute (no rescaling of the covariance by the residual variance).

params.name: tol
params.description: ftol = xtol = gtol, in [2.3e-16, 0.1].

params.name: max_nfev
params.description: Residual evaluation budget for the solver, 1..100000.

params.name: max_evals
params.description: Cap on expression evaluations, 1..2000000.

operations.name: num_quad
operations.description: One-dimensional QUADPACK integral (scipy.integrate.quad) of an expression in x over finite or infinite bounds. Statuses OK, NO_CONVERGENCE (message from QUADPACK), NON_FINITE, EVAL_LIMIT. Result: value, abserr, neval, subdivisions

params.name: f
params.description: Expression in x (no reducers, no data).

params.name: a
params.description: Lower bound: finite number or "-Inf"/"Inf".

params.name: b
params.description: Upper bound.

params.name: epsabs
params.description: Absolute tolerance in [0, 1].

params.name: epsrel
params.description: Relative tolerance in [0, 1); at least 1e-13 when epsabs is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum subdivisions, 1..1000.

params.name: points
params.description: Up to 64 break points strictly inside finite bounds.

params.name: max_evals
params.description: Cap on expression evaluations.

operations.name: num_root
operations.description: Bracketed scalar root of an expression in x (scipy.optimize brentq/bisect/ridder/toms748). f(lower) and f(upper) must be finite with opposite signs (BAD_INTERVAL otherwise). Statuses OK, NO_CONVERGENCE, EVAL_LIMIT. Result: root, f_root, iterations, function_calls

params.name: f
params.description: Expression in x (no reducers, no data).

params.name: lower
params.description: Bracket start (finite).

params.name: upper
params.description: Bracket end (finite, > lower).

params.name: method
params.description: Bracketing method.

params.name: xtol
params.description: Absolute tolerance on the bracket width (not on |f|): a loose xtol returns a root with f_root far from 0 and status OK. Must be > 0.

params.name: rtol
params.description: Relative x tolerance, >= 4*eps.

params.name: maxiter
params.description: Iterations, 1..1000.

params.name: max_evals
params.description: Cap on expression evaluations.
